name: White Bean, Spinach & Tomato Sauté over Polenta with Olive Tapenade

instructions.primary_message: In a large pot, bring broth and water to a boil. Reduce heat to low and gradually add polenta in a thin steady stream, while whisking, until the polenta is incorporated into the broth. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until polenta is soft and the texture is creamy, 15-25 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1420 ml chicken or vegetable broth
3 cup water
2 ¼ cups polenta (cornmeal)

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
3 yellow bell peppers
3 (142 g) pkg baby spinach
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Zest lemons into a small bowl. Cut lemons into wedges and set aside for serving.
Mince olives, sun-dried tomatoes, and capers; add to the bowl with the lemon zest.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup Kalamata olives, pitted
12 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed
3 tbsp capers

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl along with the oil. Stir to combine the tapenade and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers; peel and small dice onions.
Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper, onion, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add beans and tomatoes to the pot with the veggies; cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 6-7 minutes.
Add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Add oil, salt, and pepper to the polenta and stir to combine; if the polenta is too firm, add hot water, a few tablespoons at a time, until you reach a desired consistency.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide polenta and veggie sauté between bowls; top with olive tapenade and fresh basil. Serve with lemon wedges and enjoy!
